recommended.t: Goblin village spheres or mind altar teleports or a Bandosian token
Water altar teleport for quick access to Lumbridge Swamp

rewards.t: 75000 Combat XP lamp used for any combat skill (including Summoning, Prayer and Slayer, excluding necromancy) at or above level 79
50000 Combat XP lamp used for any combat skill (including Summoning, Prayer and Slayer, excluding necromancy) at or above level 69
A Kyzaj, to which you can add a Bandos hilt to increase its stats from tier 70 to tier 75.
"Honourable Kyzaj" and the "Bloodied Kyzaj" cosmetic overrides for mauls

Bandos's Memories book. Additional pages come in the form of 13 green Bandos chronicles, which can be found while exploring Yu'biusk. They are similar to Chronicle fragments from Divination, and will only appear when you come within close range of them, granting 10 Divination experience when caught.
Ability to use the God Wars Dungeon Teleport spell
Yelps's very own cash bag and Expired spin ticket. These can be reclaimed by speaking to Yelps (if spared), or by searching his Chest (if killed).
You can speak to Zarador after the quest to change your Kyzaj from an honourable to a bloodied one, and vice versa. This effect is purely cosmetic.

steps.t: Speak to councillor Ur-tag in the north-easternmost house on the floor 2 of Dorgesh-Kaan. [Chat: 2 How can I help? › Accept › Any]
Climb-down the dark hole under tree in the Lumbridge Swamp. It is northwest of the water ruins.
p: Meeting with the Bandosians in the swamp caves

steps.t: Head to the north-east in the caves and speak to the group of leaders. [Chat: Any › 5 Enough questions. › Any › Any › Any › 2 I'm done here.]
Return to Dorgesh-Kaan and speak to Zanik, who is standing near Ur-tag back at the quest start. [Chat: 2 They don't stand a chance!]

Travel to the Bandosian camp on the east side of the Goblin Village and talk to Zanik once more (a Goblin Village sphere can be used). [Chat: 1 What do you mean, dying? › 2 Go on. › 1 Don't say that. We can still save them.]
p: The portal to Yu'biusk, built on the ruins of Bandos' Tower.

steps.t: Prepare for combat before proceeding to the next step.
Enter the portal to travel to Yu'biusk.
Go around the mountain, up one ladder and follow the path south until you reach Zarador. Talk to him. [Chat: 4 I have no more rules questions. › 3 I have no more questions.]
Head to your camp (travel west, down 2 ladders into a small room with a cooking pot). Talk to Burntmeat or My Arm. [Chat: 4 Enough questions. › 1 Great, thanks! › 1 That sure is a mystery.]
p: Meeting with Grubfoot, My Arm and Burntmeat at Your Camp

steps.t: Kill the human infiltrator when he appears.

sub.t: If Burntmeat doesn't suggest searching his body, check the normal guide for possible solutions to progress the quest.

steps.t: Return east to Zarador. [Chat: 1 I'll get right on it.]
Talk to the following goblins and kill them.
Return to Zarador once all infiltrators have been dealt with. [Chat: Any]
Use the bank chest beside Zarador to bank any forbidden items. He will also explain the rules of the tournament.
Talk to him once more to begin the tournament. [Chat: 1 Just bring it!]
After defeating Yelps, you can choose to kill or spare him. [Chat: Any]
After you have made your choice speak to Zanik outside of the portal. [Chat: Any › 3 I need to get back to the tournament.]
Return to Zarador after talking to Zanik. He will inform you that your next opponent is Lol, the troll champion. [Chat: 1 Just bring it!]

sub.t: Suggested items: Stat-boosting potions such as overloads, extreme potions, or super potions, prayer potions, Enhanced Excalibur (or another good weapon), and lots of good food.
Forbidden items: You cannot wear armour, including pocket items and jewellery.

steps.t: After Lol has been defeated, you must once again choose to kill or spare him. [Chat: Any]

Talk to Zarador again and, after some dialogue, he will give you a weapon known as the Kyzaj, the namesake of the tournament. He will tell you that you must use it against your final opponent, General Graardor, the champion of the ourgs. [Chat: 3 Enough questions, give me the Kyzaj so I can practice with it.]
Talk to Zanik outside of the portal and she will teach you how to wield and use the Kyzaj. [Chat: 3 I need you to tell me about the Kyzaj.]
When you are ready to begin the final battle, return to Zarador and talk to him. [Chat: 1 Just bring it!]

sub.t: Rules for this round: You may not bring in your own weapons (you must use the Kyzaj, a tier 70 weapon), and prayer is disabled. You may equip armour and jewellery, although runes and non-combat items (excluding food) are forbidden.
The Kyzaj will automatically equip itself once the fight starts; you will not be able to equip it beforehand.
Fighting General Graardor he has three main mechanics.
The first one is a ground smash that affects the centre of the arena. Being in the centre makes you get hit for up to 5k damage.
The second attack is a cleave animation with no warning. Sidestep a few tiles and go back to attacking.
The third mechanic he will destroy a section of the outer ring. This will hit for 5k damage if you do not move to another outer ring.

p: Lol throws a big rock at you.
Zanik uses Bandos' memories to teach you how to wield the Kyzaj.
General Graardor strikes the centre of the arena, creating a shockwave.

steps.sec: The new Big High War God
steps.t: Zarador throws Zanik into the arena, giving you two choices: you may either slay Zanik or spare her. [Chat: 4 Enough questions. I need to speak to Zanik › 3 I'm ready. › Any › Any › 2 Goodbye.]

sub.t: Your Kyzaj appearance will initially depend upon your decision to kill or spare Zanik (you receive the Bloodied kyzaj if you kill her or the Honourable kyzaj if you spare her), but these can be freely exchanged after the quest.

p: Zarador throws Zanik into the Arena.
Zanik hugs you after sparing her.

steps.sec: The new Big High War God
steps.t: If you chose to kill Zanik, you must speak to General Graardor to find out his plans (Graardor can be found by going south from Zarador, up the ladder, and taking the first pathway to the west to the bank spot).  [Chat: Any]

steps.sec: The new Big High War God
steps.t: If you chose to spare Zanik, you must speak to her and find out her plans (Zanik is standing next to Zarador). [Chat: Any]

steps.sec: The new Big High War God
steps.t: Return to Ur-tag in Dorgesh-Kaan.

steps.sec: The new Big High War God
steps.t: Quest complete!
